law_scale: original reference C0 for both plans
performance_inference: descriptive paired measurements within each runner; no population-level runner confidence claim
condition_measured_advantage_rule: all three runner medians and every measured paired runtime favor candidate, with exactly identical probability counts and confidence interval; cold preparation reported separately and included in first-use totals
whole_method_success_rule: report all twelve predeclared conditions; any measured advantage is limited to the named conditions and must also survive first-use preparation costs; no replacement of the cost criterion by correctness or empirical-frequency agreement
